title: Hearty High-Protein Chinese Broccoli Noodles
description: A fermented and aerated Chinese dish featuring purple-sprouting-broccoli, caramelized to perfection and packed with high-protein ingredients, perfect for a satisfying brunch
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat and caramelize the broccoli florets for 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and stir-fry until golden brown
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and fermented bean paste
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the tofu and broccoli in the skillet and stir-fry for 2 minutes
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds
